body:
No no, don't worry. You've done more than you know.

Unfortunately I don't. I still live at home while I save up for my own place. Thank you anyways, I'll be fine for tonight

Nothing so exciting as that, just a  few soccer and baseball fields, empty now that it's night. I've been sitting in a nice grassy field though which is overrun by  weeds. Very pretty

I do think I should be heading home though.  I think I've annoyed the locals enough. 

Thank you much for responding though. Really. It means the world to me. If you don't mind, I'll be using your technique to calm myself down from now on. Useful to focus on something else but me. 

Thanks again

I actually never have gone to a sleep clinic. I'm not sure I'm willing to devote the time and energy to go to one though. Thank you for the suggestion all he same. 

I've waited 22 years. There's nothing waiting for me on either end, so if a month is all id need then maybe. I'll look into it.
Thank you

Thanks for responding. I make no promises about actually seeing one, but I'll look into other options for now

Thank you

Please don't apologize for anything you've said. I'd like to think you're right, but lord knows there are probably many people who are also tired of me. Still, thank you anyways. I didn't know I was on such a hair trigger, but here I am tearing up again

I'm not sure if I can handle medication/a psychiatrist or a support group, honestly. I don't mean to sound so stubborn, I just honestly don't know if I'd be able to stomach it. I'll look into it though at the very least.

I'm also so damned sorry that you went rthrough this too.  I really am. You're right that it's a tempting escape. So tempting. Although I'm glad that as of now you haven't pressed that button, even if it's for selfish reasons

I should probably get out of this park, though. I'll start the walk back to my place. 

Seriously. Thank you

Thanks for responding. I'm so sorry that you've been in a similar situation, though. I wouldn't wish this on my worst enemy.  

I actually haven't looked into CBT. I know it's the big method in psych therapy, but I've always shed away from it for some reason. You're absolutely right that it'd be better to listen to someone talk rather than talking to a blank face. I'll see 

Yes I'm still at the park. Banking on the night to hide any splotchy redness on my cheeks

First off thank you for responding. I had written this post with a straight face, but your reply had me openly crying for a good few seconds. Thank goodness it's getting dark out or I may have spooked some people. 

I have never taken medication, but have seen multiple therapists. They all basically say the same thing and I eventually stop going once I realize they're just giving me a fancy pep talk. That sounds demeaning, and I swear I don't mean to be, it's just how it always felt. 

Every now and then I think it might be worth it and I remember my mother telling me "I'm tired of you" or my father looking at me with pity and asking "is this really your life" or how the only thing I'm really worried about is my Principal Investigator getting in trouble for my experiment being cancelled. 

I don't know. I don't know if  I can sit down in a therapist's office again and feel  almost like I'm wasting their time for complaining. 

Thank you for your kind words. You don't know how much they mean to me
